name: Greg Abbott
summary: Gregory Wayne  Abbott ( ABB-ət; born November 13, 1957) is an American politician and lawyer serving since 2015 as the 48th Governor of Texas. A member of the Republican Party, he served from 2002 to 2015 as the 50th attorney general of Texas and from 1996 to 2001 as a justice of the Texas Supreme Court. As of 2025, Abbott is the longest-serving incumbent governor in the United States.
